name: Create a new dataset
description: Create a new dataset Creates a new DLP (Data Loss Prevention) dataset for storing custom detection patterns. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/datasets
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/datasets
Creates a new DLP (Data Loss Prevention) dataset for storing custom detection patterns. Datasets can contain exact match data, word lists, or EDM (Exact Data Match) configurations.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — Dataset description.

name: Prepare to upload a new version of a dataset
description: Prepare to upload a new version of a dataset Creates a new version of a DLP dataset, allowing you to stage changes before activation. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/datasets/{dataset_id}/upload
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/datasets/{dataset_id}/upload
Creates a new version of a DLP dataset, allowing you to stage changes before activation. Used for single-column EDM and custom word lists.
Required: account_id (path); dataset_id (path)

name: Sets the column information for a multi-column upload
description: Sets the column information for a multi-column upload This is used for multi-column EDMv2 datasets. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/datasets/{dataset_id}/versions/{version}

name: Delete a dataset
description: Delete a dataset This deletes all versions of the dataset. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/datasets/{dataset_id}

name: Fetch a specific dataset
description: Fetch a specific dataset Gets a dataset and its latest upload status. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/datasets/{dataset_id}

name: Fetch all datasets
description: Fetch all datasets Lists all DLP datasets configured for the account, including custom word lists and EDM datasets. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/datasets
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/datasets
Lists all DLP datasets configured for the account, including custom word lists and EDM datasets.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update details about a dataset
description: Update details about a dataset Updates the configuration of an existing DLP dataset, such as its name, description, or detection settings. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/datasets/{dataset_id}

name: Upload a new version of a multi-column dataset
description: Upload a new version of a multi-column dataset This is used for multi-column EDMv2 datasets. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/datasets/{dataset_id}/versions/{version}/entries/{entry_id}

name: Upload a new version of a dataset
description: Upload a new version of a dataset This is used for single-column EDMv1 and Custom Word Lists. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/datasets/{dataset_id}/upload/{version}
